task_completion.description: Agent successfully opens the DICOM viewer and loads the CT scan from the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A DICOM viewer application (e.g., Horos, Weasis, or similar) is open showing a CT scan of the chest/torso.

task_completion.description: Agent demonstrates switching between different window settings (Lung, Bone, Soft Tissue, Mediastinal).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the image contrast and brightness changing significantly to highlight different tissues (e.g., black/white lung parenchyma vs. bright white bone).

task_completion.description: Agent performs linear or area measurements on anatomical structures in each of the four windows.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Measurement callouts, calipers, or rulers are visible on the CT slices across different window views.

task_completion.description: Agent exports the annotated views as PNG files to the designated export directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save As' or 'Export' dialog box is seen with the file format set to PNG and the path pointing to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/.

task_completion.description: Agent creates a text report containing the window preset, structure measured, and measurement value for all four windows.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal view shows the file /home/ga/DICOM/exports/multiwindow_survey_report.txt with four distinct entries matching the visual measurements.

integrity.description: Agent used the medical imaging GUI to perform measurements rather than script-based manipulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Mouse cursor movement, active tool selection (ruler/annotation tool), and GUI menus are visible in the trajectory.

integrity.description: Measurements are derived from the actual image data, not placeholder values.
integrity.visual_evidence: The measurement values in the final report match the numerical values displayed on the calipers in the GUI screenshots.

integrity.description: Agent did not simply move pre-existing files but generated them through the application.
integrity.visual_evidence: The export process (dialog boxes or 'Export' button clicks) is captured in the screenshots.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must use the following window settings: Lung (W:1500, L:-500), Bone (W:2000, L:300), Soft Tissue (W:400, L:40), and Mediastinal (W:350, L:50). The source DICOM is located at /home/ga/DICOM/studies/multiwindow_ct/ and all outputs (4 PNGs and 1 TXT report) must be saved to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/. The report must correlate exactly with the visual measurements taken in the GUI.
